source_law.text: If the driver of a vehicle intends to turn at an intersection and: The turn is a right turn, both the approach for the right turn and the right turn must be made from the right turn lane if the highway has a right turn lane as set forth in subsection 4 of NRS 484B.223 [NRS-484B-223-4a, NRS-484B-223-4b], or must be made from the extreme right lane.
